message.text: There is no Redis configuration. The cache layer uses in-process memory. User entries expire after 10 minutes via DefaultTTL in Store.New.

args.command: grep -rni "redis" /bench/repo --include='*.go' --include='*.md' --include='*.yaml' --include='*.json' | grep -v node_modules | grep -v proto/gen | head -20

message.text: The repository contains no Redis configuration. The cache layer does not use Redis.

r01.
There is no Redis connection. Caching is an in-process `store/cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go`) created in `store.New` (`store/store.go`) with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`. User rows go through `userCache.Set` (`store/user.go`), which uses that default TTL; there is no per-user override.
